notes_for_editor: The only source for the lookout is the Eastern US Lookouts page, which gives the name and county only. The record point (30.96222, -87.395) comes from that page's map widget. The USGS entry 'CANOE CRK TOWERSITE' (USGS 305739087233201) is a groundwater well with coordinates 30.96102, -87.39220, about 300 m from the record point by my calculation. It is the only physical clue, and its name does not establish a lookout; the well's only data entry is a 1957 field measurement. Two searches and the 2015 Florida Chapter lookout report (no match for Canoe Creek or Escambia) found nothing else. Status and access stay unknown.
